Commandos''', '''Tech Tactician''', '''The Little Medic''', '''Unyielding Shooter''', '''Wednesday the 30th'''. ***Reduced the cost from {{Coins|800}} to {{Coins|525}} for the '''Back From Infernal''', '''You're Being Recorded''', '''A Cold Tyrant''', '''Fallen Angel''', '''Love Launcher''', '''Suppressing Fire''', '''Undead Solider''' and '''The Underworld Dreg'''. ***Reduced the cost from {{Coins|1,000}} to {{Coins|650}} for the '''Condemned Vigilante''', '''Corrupted Touch''', '''Forbidden Magic''', '''Frozen Impact''', '''Heart Smasher''', '''Heartbreaker''', '''Joker of Hearts''', '''Mysterious Drifter''', '''Happy New Years!''', '''🇺🇸 Rise for the Pledge!''', '''Romantic Reaper''', '''Underworld Warden''' and '''Place Farm, Live Better'''. ***Reduced the cost from {{Coins|1,500}} to {{Coins|1,000}} for the '''Hazardous Haste'''. *Updated triumph UI. **Now shows the [[Levels]] bar. **Now displays the mode type and its difficulty. **Now has a play again button. **Consumable rewards now display the number given instead of name. **Displayed towers now play their idle animations. *Battle pass UI is now hidden when it is over. *Restarting the match now has a ready prompt appear instead of a 120 second wave timer. *Fixed [[Snowballer]] not being able to damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies at Level 0-2. *Fixed [[Assassin]] and [[Slasher]] not being able to target [[Flying]] enemies, instead just staring at them. While they can be targeted now, they are completely unable to be damaged by them outside of [[Slasher]]'s bleed. *Fixed [[Necromancer]]'s damage not changing based on the number of enemies targeted. *Fixed [[Necromancer]] having issues with it not targeting every enemy it can with its beams at Level 4. *Fixed towers being able to summon units before every players selects that they are ready. *Fixed [[Skeleton]] having varied health values depending on if the map has [[Enemies Beta]] or not. *Fixed [[Archer]]'s [[gamepass]] still being giftable. *Fixed [[Medic]] causing unexpected losses in a match. *Fixed '''Raft Wars''' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]] fourth and fifth objective being possible to complete on any map and not requiring [[Turret]]s to be placed down. *Fixed '''Hazardous Haste''' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]] not tracking [[Polluted Wasteland II]] triumphs. *Fixed [[Lost Souls]] icon appearing at all times in [[Pizza Party]]. :In '''v1.74.0a''':
